title: Overview of fluid hammer phenomenon's physical implications and numerical modeling on satellite propulsion applications
author: Allan Lima Verde de Araujo Fernandes

advisors.name: Luís Eduardo Vergueiro Loures da Costa

abstract: This thesis offers insights on how to model satellite priming apparatus so to obtain representative fluid hammer numerical results. It does so by providing a background for the main phenomena involved; and by examining a particular engineering solution for this problem, going into some of the details of the implementation choices. The solution analyzed is the European Space Propulsion System Simulation (ESPSS) libraries of the EcosimPro programing environment. Experimental databases are used to assert the quality of the numerical results and to provide relevant auxiliary insights.
